text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa's racing attire has arrived.
Apparently, Umamusume can design their own attire
based on their personal preferences, but—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
A particular preference? Nah, don't have one.
...Except for one thing, that is.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Take a guess.

Nakayama Festa smirks mischievously, as if
measuring my competence. What could be the
single thing she refuses to compromise on?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hold on, hold on.
Since you're here, let's play a game.
If you win, I'll tell ya.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Why, it is a simple game.
—We merely play with this.

Saying so, Nakayama Festa pulled three dice
from her pocket and rolled them across the desk.
The scattered numbers pointed up toward the ceiling.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Roll it 5 times and guess how many doubles come up.
It's a lame game, but it should kill time until training.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Though, if you lose... well, I guess I'll think of something then.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well now, you getting on? Or not?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hah, now that's more like it!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it's a tiny game, let's enjoy it to the fullest.
Since we're doing it anyway, right?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, don't be such a buzzkill.
You've only got two choices: do it, or don't.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You're not such a coward that you'd get spooked
by a lukewarm game like this, are you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's fine.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, answer me.
...How many times will matching dice come up?

Is this a matter of probability?
Logically speaking, getting matching numbers
in just about five tries... feels unlikely.

Then again, my opponent is Nakayama Festa.
Could it be that
she can roll whatever number she desires...?

...No. Even so, they would never do such a thing.
If that's the case—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Now that you've come this far, make a bigger gamble.
You're the one rolling the dice, after all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Go ahead and start, Trainer.

...To think I would end up rolling it myself.
However, this allows me to say with absolute certainty that the number of doubles rolled was zero—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha!
You've got real talent, Trainer.
To think you'd nail it on the first try!"
All the dice on the desk show 1s—snake eyes.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
This isn't rigged or anything.
It's just the number that happened to come up.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Still... a result is a result.
Right now, you just lost to yourself.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The moment you refuse to take a gamble,
win or lose, all you're left with is boredom.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's not about luck or probability.
The one rolling these dice is myself.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —This is a match between you and me.

...I lost the game.
Yet Nakayama Festa just gave me
the uncompromising answer I sought.

What she always holds close to her heart.
The thrill found along the road of competition, gambling, and victory.
That burning excitement of rolling the dice, always—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Now then, as for you, the loser...
Let's see. How about spending some scorching time with me
in a much hotter game?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Let's head out to the track, Trainer.
That's where our next contest will be.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Don't go boring me now, got it?
